QuestInfo.name: [World Tour] Five Mini-games for an EXP Coupon
QuestInfo.0:
Participate in the bull run from Spain, the city race from Singapore, and the pinball game from the 
United States. Travelers who clear any one of them 5 times get a 2x EXP Coupon!
